claims: Microsoft released an emergency out-of-band (OOB) update KB5085516 for Windows 11 versions 24H2 and 25H2 as of March 22, 2026.
KB5085516 fixes broken internet connectivity and Microsoft Account sign-in issues in apps like Teams, OneDrive, and Outlook.
Broken internet connectivity and Microsoft Account sign-in issues in apps like Teams, OneDrive, and Outlook were caused by the March 10 update KB5079473.
KB5084897 fixed a bug where Bluetooth devices were not appearing in Settings/Quick Settings on Enterprise devices.
KB5084597 patched a critical network security vulnerability
